name: Private media streaming and bounded fallback

implementation.worker_primary: Existing private Worker remains preferred. Every new read/seek retains the signed capability and current-authority backchannel. No Worker code, bucket, binding, secret, deploy or cache setting changes.
implementation.proxy_and_fallback: Worker download=1 proxy and internal S3/R2 GETs use streamed HTTPX responses in 64 KiB chunks. Local delivery uses asynchronous FileResponse with the same private MIME/disposition policy. S3 reads are signed internally with SigV4 and an ETag If-Match condition; signed URLs never leave the backend.
implementation.bounds: 64 media-body requests have a separate immediate admission limit from 64 ordinary requests. Capability JSON remains ordinary. Each transfer has a total 300-second bound; upstream read-idle is 10 seconds, connect 5 seconds; response/client cleanup is shielded and bounded to 5 seconds.
implementation.security: Authorization occurs before storage access. Private/no-store and nosniff remain enforced. Redirects are refused; upstream errors do not expose XML/HTML or signed URLs. Truncated bodies fail the stream instead of reporting completion. Local resolved paths cannot escape storage via symlinks.
implementation.http_contract: GET/HEAD, single inclusive/open/suffix ranges, 200/206/416, If-Range, Content-Type, Content-Disposition and Content-Length remain supported. HEAD describes the full representation without reading a body. No frontend/player/upload/module-label change.

worker_fastapi_contract.scope: Existing Worker source + real FastAPI ASGI; synthetic authority/R2; no deployed-edge or live-bucket claim

frontend_test_reuse.reason: No frontend source change; integration/Worker/stream tests cover the changed backend boundary.
